name: ActivityPub Reader
description: Integrates ActivityPub timelines with the Personal Reader module, providing a fediverse reading/interaction UI.
project_description: Submodule of the ActivityPub project that implements the Personal Reader (drupal/reader) hooks, exposing ActivityPub home/notifications/direct/bookmark timelines, sources (follow/unfollow), authors, single posts and per-item/post actions (like, announce, reply, bookmark, delete, mute) inside the Reader UI. It renders stored ActivityPub activities and remote content into the reader's channels and timelines for a logged-in user.
